dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Approximately five prominent light-toned 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible on the dark dorsal pelage. The perimeter geometry of these rings is irregular and fragmented, with a soft pixel gradient transitioning from the high-intensity interior to the low-intensity exterior. The central-most structure exhibits a jagged, non-uniform boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of small, high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated in the posterior region near the flipper junction. These clusters lack an internal gradient and appear as solid, high-contrast speckles against the dark background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most distinct dorsal macro-annuli form an elongated scalene triangle. When connected to the centroid of the largest high-intensity blob cluster near the tail, the resulting geometric relationship forms an irregular quadrilateral with its longest axis parallel to the spine.

other_distinctive_markers: An intricate labyrinthine pattern of interconnected light-colored lines forms a unique reticulated texture on the upper right lateral flank, distinct from the discrete circular annuli.
